snippet.textDisplay:
I hate to be that guy but I really don’t think this is going to run past 45-60fps even on PC for 90% of gamers. They chose photorealism as a focal point for this game - that’s expensive no matter how you cut it. We don’t have the improvements in hardware to make this economic for most low-medium grade builds with modern hardware (and I’d argue people with the newer hardware are running the lower ends because the shit is so expensive right now.)

Hoping for the best but definitely not expecting it.

snippet.textDisplay:
Hey Jack, I just wanted to say that I probably won’t watch this series, mainly because of my personal concerns and feelings towards Rockstar and their business practices. I feel as though, with the current market and the profit-minded focus they are pursuing, is actively poisoning the community of gaming as a whole. 

As it stands, I have not watched the video, you may bring this up in your own words or videos later on, but I will not know. I hope you do, considering how outspoken you have been in the past towards certain practices, whether it be from companies or influencers themselves. As it stands though, I just personally cannot see a benefit for watching this play through. 

I’m not saying people shouldn’t buy the game, or continue supporting either Rockstar or you, but, in my own personal opinion, I do not see myself engaging in this series. I look forward to your other videos and projects in the future, I’ll probably still be a fan until the day you retire, but this game isn’t for me. 

I genuinely hope you enjoy it though and wish you nothing but the best!
